name: Paper.io 2
tagline: Draw a loop. Claim the map. Guard your trail.
description: Everyone races across one map. Leave your home to draw a trail, then return to your land to claim everything inside. Cut another player's trail to send them home. Most land after two minutes wins.
howToPlay: Tap arrows to steer. Leave your land and return to claim a loop; you cannot reverse.
Cut rival trails. A crash clears your land outside home; return after three seconds.
Most land after two minutes wins. Walls, your own trail and head-on crashes send you home.
